reason: The README clearly identifies this as a DeepSeek Harness web GUI theme plugin providing theme presets, an OKLCH theme designer, persistent customization, and JSON theme token exchange.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OKLCH 的主题预设与设计器，支持实时调色、主题应用、持久化以及 JSON 主题令牌导入导出。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web theme plugin with OKLCH-based presets and a designer for real-time color customization, persistent themes, and JSON token import and export.

capabilities: customizes the DeepSeek Harness web interface theme
provides theme preset and designer controls
supports JSON theme token import and export
exposes a host route for AI-generated theme names and descriptions
